## Kind of change

Tick exactly one. Anything else needs the owner's exception first.

- [ ] Fix: the commit says what was wrong
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test or CI for tests
- [ ] Security hardening that only narrows what is accepted (`fix(security):` in the title)
- [ ] Dependency security update
- [ ] Feature, setting, REST or schema change: I have the owner's **freeze exception** (link the issue with the label `freeze-exception`)

## Checks

- [ ] `task check` passes for every commit
- [ ] No secret, key, token, join token or backup file in the diff, the logs or the description
